newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit still at 68 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit still at 68 pct.

text.p: Ramping up of the 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear power plant at Richland, Washington, will be delayed until at least the middle of the week, a spokesman for the plant said Monday.
The plant, which remains at 68 percent power, had been expected to return to full power Monday.
Operations have been curtailed since mid-January due to the latest round of problems with a computerized adjustable speed drive installed at the plant last year.
The spokesman said further study of the cause of the problem is ongoing and work is also underway to install monitoring equipment before full start-up is attempted again.
Meanwhile, WNP-2 is scheduled to close for a 42-day refueling outage on April 12.
